name: PromptInput
purpose: The chat composer: auto-growing text, attachments, toolbar slot, Send ↔ Stop, / and @ menus.
description: The composer of an AI chat or agent panel: an auto-growing text area, attachment chips, a toolbar slot for the Model selector and tool toggles, and one button that switches between Send and Stop. Typing `/` or `@` opens a command or mention menu. Part of the Agent kit.

onSubmit.notes: Called with the trimmed text and the attachments on Enter or the send button

onStop.notes: Called by the stop button while `status` is `submitted` or `streaming`

status.notes: Figma: State — `submitted` and `streaming` turn Send into Stop and block new submits.

placeholder.notes: Figma: Placeholder — a hint, never the label

label.notes: Accessible name of the text area (visually hidden)

attachments.notes: Figma: Attachments — chips above the text

onAttach.notes: Figma: Attach button — shows the paperclip button; open your file picker here

onRemoveAttachment.notes: Called by a chip's remove button

toolbar.notes: Figma: Toolbar slot — left of the bottom bar (ModelSelector, tool toggles)

actions.notes: Figma: Actions slot — right of the bottom bar, before Send (ContextMeter, voice)

triggers.notes: Figma: Command menu — "/" and "@" menus that open while typing

disclaimer.notes: Figma: Disclaimer — one line under the input ("AI can make mistakes. Check important info.")

maxRows.notes: Rows before the text area scrolls

size.notes: Figma: Size — md for side panels, lg for a full-page chat

autoFocus.notes: Focuses the text area on mount — only on pages whose main task is the chat

submitLabel.notes: Accessible name of the send button

stopLabel.notes: Accessible name of the stop button

clearOnSubmit.notes: Clears the text after submit (uncontrolled only)

do: Keep one Prompt input per conversation, docked at the bottom of the thread.
Put the Model selector in the Toolbar slot and the Context meter in the Actions slot.
Show Stop while the agent works and keep the text area editable, so people can draft the next message.
Block Send while a file is still uploading; show the upload state on its chip.
Add a one-line disclaimer when answers can be wrong.
forbidden: Never disable the text area while streaming — only Send is blocked.
Never use the placeholder as the only label.
Never put more than one primary action in the bar: Send is the primary action.
Never move focus out of the text area when the reply arrives.
Never send on Enter while a command menu is open — Enter inserts the highlighted item.
